about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for hse-indg401 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The paragraph after the list is merged into the last bullet, and the 'mobile platform' exception is merged into the 'seven days' bullet.
findings.evidence: tree: "at intervals not exceeding seven days. Where it is a mobile platform, a new inspection and report is not required"

findings.problem: The three sub-points under 'take account of factors such as' are flattened to the same level as the main bullets, and the WAIT paragraph is joined to the last one.
findings.evidence: tree: "• the risks to the safety of everyone where the work equipment will be used. If you are still unsure which type of equipment to use"

findings.problem: Paragraphs that follow a bullet list are joined onto the last bullet, so an employer duty reads as part of an employee bullet.
findings.evidence: tree: "before continuing). You must consult your employees" / "the best ways of providing information and training. Employers can ask employees"

findings.problem: The page footer imprint is kept as a text block under Further information.
findings.evidence: tree: "Published by the Health and Safety Executive 01/14 INDG401(rev2) Page 7 of 7"
